name: Keeper
description: The Keeper dashboard as a panel, a count of queries waiting for your approval, and a notice that opens the approval queue when one arrives. The extension only reads the queue; approving is always your click in the dashboard.

notify.description: Notify when a query starts waiting for your approval

pollSeconds.description: Seconds between queue checks while Pine is focused or approvals wait (2 to 300)

idlePollSeconds.description: Seconds between queue checks in the background with nothing waiting (10 to 3600)
